title_zh: 说明手肘不适并确认下午就诊时间

scenario.goal_zh: 准确说明不适位置并确认预约时间

context_zh: 虚构来电者向诊所描述不适位置并预约，不涉及诊断或治疗建议。
author: author-phase07-b

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: Could I book an appointment? My right elbow has been hurting since yesterday.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist
sentences.text: I'll note the location and when it started. We have an appointment at three thirty this afternoon. Can you come then?

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: Yes. Is that at the main clinic?

sentences.speaker: Receptionist
sentences.text: That's right, on Oak Street. Please arrive ten minutes early for the appointment.

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: Thank you. I'll be there at three twenty.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist
sentences.text: You're booked for three thirty today. The clinician will ask you more about the pain when you arrive.
